title: The Library tile click timing walk passes again when one tile is clicked straight after another
goal: The walk that times how fast a picked title tile on the video Library shelf shows as picked now fails: when the pick moves from one title tile to the next, the first click on the second tile is never seen as picked. Either a click is really being lost, which a person would feel as a dead click, or the walk is reading it too early; find which and make it pass.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-12 on main at 5862475dd with no local change to the app (Library.swift put back to HEAD): Scripts/playtest-all.sh library-tile-click-latency-walk -> 'FAILED step 11 (timeTileClicks): click 1 on "Keynote Section" never picked it'. The step's own note in log.json: 'switching from tile to tile: "Film Super", 10 clicks: picked on screen median 14ms ... "Keynote Section" ... never picked on click 1'. Step 9 (from nothing picked) passes. library-tile-click-latency-picture-walk passes. Found while running Library walks for a-saved-stroke-tile-on-the-styles-shelf-counts-e.
acceptance: The log says whether a click was lost in the app or the walk read the pick too early, and the fix is in the one that was wrong
